ratings_why.fun: The curve climbs cleanly: extra lives win the early fights, the Barnstormer and Wreath-Layer start real growth at Tier 3, and Hesketh and Ardea turn a busy fight into a big next turn.
ratings_why.distinct: A death that pays out and keeps the body, then pays again at Start of Turn, plays unlike Reborn or plain deathrattles, though it still sits close to BG's Undead.

verdict_why: The v2 rules gaps are closed and the tier jobs are all filled; more passes would change numbers, not make it play better.

points.text: Growth has a good shape: Curtain Call moves in-fight deaths into next turn's stats, so the board visibly grows from what the fight did. Keep that two-beat rhythm.

Blood-and-Thunder with Broken Heart and Old Crest throws about 15 to 20 splashes of up to 10, around four times the Tier 5 in-fight guide. It ends with the fight, so it's a high roll, not a loop; leave it hot for the owner to tune.
Žaltys's +2/+3 to the smallest Trouper is a weak Tier 4 buffer. Letting it hit the smallest Trouper once per friendly kill it saved would tie the buff to its real job.

The Barnstormer with the Wreath-Layer gets about +6/+6 a fight at Tier 3 (three wreaths plus three Curtain Calls). That's the tribe's best mid-game line, as it should be, but it can decide the board early.
Say what happens to the Matron's egg when both hand and board are full; most players will assume it is lost.

standouts.why: The Barnstormer is cheap fuel for every count and a clear Tier 3 engine; hitting him is what makes the tribe go.
Mr Ardea Grey's visible rave-or-pan threshold is a capstone you plan the whole board around.
Dame Natrix's three scripted deaths make each fight a little show, and Broken Heart is a real mass payoff.

weakest.why: Žaltys's own stats line is thin for Tier 4; it's only good when the Villain or Berus are out.
The Natterjack pays at most 2 gold and only after deaths, so it's slow economy for Tier 2.
The Brothers Berus are a pure enabler with a small body; without Žaltys the duel can cost a real unit.

flags.note: Golden Blood-and-Thunder with Old Crest and Broken Heart can clear an enemy board at Start of Combat; capped per throw but not per fight.
A free Hatchling every turn speeds triples and Discovers; with two Matrons it could run away.
Wreath-Layer with the Barnstormer is permanent growth at Tier 2-3 above the guide; the four-a-fight cap holds it.
